content:
Apple has recently raised prices on most of its products, but the iPhone and other products are expected to increase in price again next month.

With the launch of the iPhone 18 series, iPhones are expected to become even more expensive, and Apple Watch and AirPods may also be affected.

Earlier this year, Apple had already raised the prices of several products.

Mac, iPad, Apple TV, HomePod, and Vision Pro all saw price increases at the same time.

CEO Tim Cook had previewed the price hikes in advance, but it was still shocking to see so many products raise prices all at once.

In that round of price increases, the only flagship products unaffected were:

  • iPhone
  • Apple Watch
  • AirPods

At the time, Apple hinted there would be more price increases, and analysts also believed that the few unaffected products would soon see price hikes.

There is now widespread expectation that iPhones will increase in price at the iPhone 18 launch event in September.

According to rumours, the iPhone 18 Pro is expected to start at $1,299 to $1,399, while the iPhone 17 Pro was priced at $1,099.

Apple typically lowers the price of older models when launching new iPhones, but this year older models are expected to maintain their current prices or see slight increases.

Both the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 may see price hikes, as the current AI-driven memory crisis is also affecting component costs for watches.

Finally, AirPods may also see a price increase. Since the rising costs of memory and storage chips have a smaller impact on AirPods, the likelihood of a price hike is lower than for iPhone and Apple Watch.

However, if Apple plans to raise prices across its entire product lineup, including AirPods, it will be revealed at the September event.

What price changes do you expect from Apple? Let us know in the comments.
